headline: Thailand Pledges No New EV Import Curbs Ahead of 2027 Tax Increase
summary: Thailand's Industry Ministry said it will not impose new curbs on electric vehicle imports before higher excise tax rates take effect on January 1, 2027, avoiding potential trade barrier disputes.
why: Thailand is Southeast Asia's major automotive production center, balancing EV adoption incentives with protection for domestic manufacturing.

impacts.name: Thai Automotive Sector
impacts.why: The decision provides regulatory stability for vehicle importers ahead of scheduled excise tax increases in 2027.
